title: Review workflow: keys move from workflow_call secrets to per-job environments
summary: The reusable review-check workflow stops declaring `workflow_call` secrets and stops asking callers to pass them. Instead, each called job that needs a key names the `review` (or `fork-review`) environment itself and reads `secrets.<NAME>` from it, so the keys stay environment secrets of the repository that holds the caller. The caller workflow drops `secrets: inherit`, the adopter guide drops the by-name secret mapping, and the workflow tests now assert that no `workflow_call` secret is declared and that the caller passes none.

nodes.label: review.yml caller
nodes.subtitle: one job, calls only
nodes.summary: The caller job invokes the reusable workflow with inputs only. The `secrets: inherit` line is gone, and the comment now says each called job names the environment itself.

nodes.label: review-check.yml
nodes.subtitle: workflow_call, no secrets
nodes.summary: The reusable workflow's `on.workflow_call` block no longer declares VERIFIER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY, OPENAI_API_KEY, CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN or OPENROUTER_API_KEY. The header comment now explains that the keys are environment secrets read by the jobs that need them.

nodes.label: build job
nodes.summary: Builds the osf binary the reviewer jobs run. Reads no key.

nodes.label: reviewer jobs
nodes.subtitle: codex, claude, opencode
nodes.summary: Each reviewer job names the `review` environment (or `fork-review` for a fork) and reads its own key from `secrets.<NAME>` there. A reviewer whose key is empty still runs, cannot sign in, and counts as could-not-run.

nodes.label: collect & post job
nodes.subtitle: mints verifier app token
nodes.summary: The last job collects the saved answers, decides, and posts. It alone mints the verifier app's token, reading VERIFIER_APP_PRIVATE_KEY from the `review` environment it names.

nodes.label: review environment
nodes.subtitle: main-branch limited
nodes.summary: Holds the reviewer keys and the verifier app private key as environment secrets. Its limit to the main branch still applies because the jobs that read it name it.

nodes.label: fork-review environment
nodes.summary: The environment a fork pull request's reviewer jobs name instead of `review`.

nodes.label: environment secrets
nodes.subtitle: secrets.<NAME>
nodes.summary: The secret store a called job reads from once it names an environment. A key missing from it resolves to an empty string with no error.

nodes.label: OpenAI
nodes.summary: The codex reviewer's provider, reached with OPENAI_API_KEY.

nodes.label: Anthropic
nodes.summary: The claude reviewer's provider, reached with CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN.

nodes.label: OpenRouter
nodes.summary: The opencode reviewer's provider, reached with OPENROUTER_API_KEY.

nodes.label: review_workflow.rs
nodes.subtitle: workflow shape assertions
nodes.summary: The tests drop the `declared_secrets` parser and now assert that no `workflow_call` secret is declared, that the jobs still read their keys, that the caller contains no `secrets:`, and that the guide maps no secret.

nodes.label: development.md guide
nodes.subtitle: adopter example
nodes.summary: The adopter example drops the `secrets:` mapping and the prose now says the caller passes no secret and that the keys are environment secrets of the repository holding the caller.
